title: Community Emulate Check
intro: This is your community article as it is in Git now (the text of the copy I sent you on 2026-10-25), with the strict Emulate check you asked for: every paragraph that isn't yours word for word, compared with your published post, your own answers and the edits you and GPT made in Substack.

It found much less than in the hypnosis guide: no spaces before full stops, no typos of that kind, and the references are as you have them. Changes you made yourself (your Substack edits, your answers 57 to 65 and your caveat cuts) stay as they are. What's left is these six cards, each with your own version beside it.
Click Approve, Reject or Revise on each card. If your post is already up with the last copy, I'll give you the few words to change in Substack, or a new copy, once you've answered.

suggestions.title: A practice group already is community

edits.before: People sometimes buy forty acres and then bring all their unprocessed stuff with them to a more scenic location. It’s a more beautiful view for sure, but now you have the conflict PLUS goats. A group that practices together weekly for two years may never own land. So what? It can still make a difference when people are going through a divorce, an illness or grief. Parenting too, and plain old loneliness.
edits.after: People sometimes buy forty acres and then bring all their unprocessed stuff with them to a more scenic location. It’s a more beautiful view for sure, but now you have the conflict PLUS goats. A group that practices together weekly for two years may never own land. So what? It’s already a real piece of community, and it can still make a difference when people are going through a divorce, an illness or grief. Parenting too, and plain old loneliness.

suggestions.title: Who steps aside, and the appeal

edits.before: This power to remove people is so easily abused, though. So work out the process before it’s about anyone in particular. What counts as cause for immediate protective action? Who decides to put temporary restrictions on someone? Who will make sure all the evidence is preserved? How will the person be able to reply to the concerns? What protections will there be for the person’s interests (housing, records, family contact, access to common resources, outside funds if any) during the separation? When is it time to bring in outside help?
edits.after: This power to remove people is so easily abused, though. So work out the process before it’s about anyone in particular. What counts as cause for immediate protective action? Who has to step aside because they’re too close to it? Who decides to put temporary restrictions on someone? Who will make sure all the evidence is preserved? How will the person be able to reply to the concerns? What review or appeal is possible without endangering others? What protections will there be for the person’s interests (housing, records, family contact, access to common resources, outside funds if any) during the separation? When is it time to bring in outside help?

Emulate's list kept the others and dropped who is recused and the appeal.

suggestions.title: Autonomy doesn't erase rights

edits.before: Note that “outside” doesn’t have to mean the nation-state. My research initially leaned too far that way. The basic need here is for a competent level of authority that is not reviewing its own conduct. That could mean another community, a federation of communities, professionals, autonomous regional institutions, courts, regulatory agencies, emergency services, etc. The key is that it’s not the same people.
edits.after: Note that “outside” doesn’t have to mean the nation-state. My research initially leaned too far that way. The basic need here is for a competent level of authority that is not reviewing its own conduct. That could mean another community, a federation of communities, professionals, autonomous regional institutions, courts, regulatory agencies, emergency services, etc. The key is that it’s not the same people. And a community’s autonomy doesn’t let it take away rights a person can’t sign away, or make the law outside disappear.

suggestions.why: Your published lines: "The Zapatistas are an important correction here: autonomous institutions can review local power without becoming the state. But autonomy is not permission to erase non-waivable individual rights, and it does not make outside jurisdiction disappear." The list already has "autonomous regional institutions"; Emulate dropped the limit.
